title: Fragment pack meta.json
description: skills/faion/fragments/<pack>/meta.json. One meta.json per pack directory gates every fragment file beneath it, the same directory-coverage rule vfs-pack applies. Enforced by scripts/validate-fragments.py.

slug.description: Pack identity in the tier manifest. Suffixed -fragments so a pack slug can never collide with a fragment name.

tier.description: Gate for every fragment in the pack. Must be <= the tier of every recipe that composes one of them.

summary.description: What the pack is for, in the terms an agent picking a pack from fragments/INDEX.xml needs. This string is copied verbatim into the index.
